decision: held: no open full text for any declared PMID (15565808 Cancer Invest 2004; 16039414 Maturitas 2005; 17565936 Adv Ther 2007), so methods cannot be verified; the abstracts also show none is likely to qualify (uncontrolled pilot; primary ITT analysis not superior to placebo; fluoxetine comparator without placebo), and Dr. Pham's A048 efficacy hold stays
summary: Abstracts only. 15565808 is a single-arm 4-week Remifemin pilot (21 completers); 16039414 (Cr 99 extract, 122 women, 12 weeks) found no superiority over placebo in its primary ITT analysis, only in a Kupperman >=20 subgroup; 17565936 compared black cohosh with fluoxetine (no placebo, 33% dropout per arm). No context is approved. The record's notes still asserted a 'consistently favorable' safety profile, which Dr. Pham rejected; record_updates replaces that sentence.

record_updates.notes: Black cohosh evidence is mixed. Several trials show meaningful hot flash reduction (PMID: 15565808, 16039414, 17565936), but best-controlled RCTs (PMID: 19609225) found no significant benefit vs placebo at 12 months. The Kupperman Index reduction was significant only in moderate-to-severe subgroup. Dr. Pham's returned A048 decision rejects describing the safety profile as consistently favorable; safety is assessed by its own owner. Typical dose is 40mg/day standardized extract.
